description.en: Retro DOS-style terminal component kit and vintage cyber interface library.
description.zh: 充满复古极客工业质感的 DOS 终端风格组件套件与赛博怀旧界面库。

content.en: SRCL (Sacred Computer Retro Library) is an evocative interface toolkit recreating the aesthetic of vintage personal computers, early MS-DOS consoles, and CRT monitor green screens. It features raw monospace borders, bevelled buttons, and authentic blinking command prompts.
content.zh: SRCL（Sacred Computer Retro Library）是一套致敬早期个人计算机、MS-DOS 控制台与绿色阴极射线管（CRT）荧光屏质感的先锋组件库。全库严格还原了纯单色等宽框线、经典斜切倒角按钮与扫描线滤镜，为极客项目与概念艺术站点注入纯正复古赛博灵魂。
